responsibility: Implements GCC’s language-independent predefined macro setup for front ends that use cpplib. This file parses the configured compiler version and defines core builtins such as __GNUC__/__VERSION__, atomic memory-order constants, optimization and sanitizer macros, PIC/PIE indicators, LP64 markers, and target-derived type-size, alignment, endianness, and pointer-size macros, translating global compilation flags and basic target type properties into the preprocessor namespace.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the cppbuiltin pair: it parses BASEVER and emits the predefined macros into cpplib, including __GNUC__ version macros, atomic constants, optimization/sanitizer markers, LP64, endianness, and type-size macros. Unlike gcc/cppbuiltin.h, it does not just declare parse_basever and the macro-installation entry point; it performs the actual macro definition work.
